note: Targeted benchmark round 2 (v0.6 strategy): 12 priority atoms straight to Confidence B. 3 families x 6 scenes x 3 seeds x 2 conditions = 108 images per atom, 1296 total. Atom names use core.json `en` display values.

scenes.prompt: portrait of a woman standing by a window
a street scene with a cyclist passing by
a ceramic mug on a wooden table
a cat sitting on a windowsill
a modern building facade seen from below

questions.macro: Is this a macro shot where a very small subject fills the frame with extreme close-up detail? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.telephoto compression: Does the image show strong telephoto-lens characteristics (flattened/compressed perspective, isolated subject, heavily blurred busy background)? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.fisheye lens: Does the image show clear fisheye-lens distortion (strong barrel curvature of straight lines, warped wide frame)? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.rim light: Does the subject have a clear rim light (bright edge/outline light separating it from the background)? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.backlit silhouette: Is the main subject backlit (light source behind the subject creating a silhouette or bright glowing outline)? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.neon glow: Are colorful neon lights a dominant visual element in the image? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.teal and orange: Does the color grading show the teal-and-orange look (cool teal/blue-green shadows paired with warm orange highlights)? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.film grain: Does the image visibly show analog film-grain texture (fine grain/noise structure rather than digital smoothness)? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.pastel colors: Is the color palette dominantly pastel (soft, pale, low-saturation tones)? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.ink wash painting: Is the image in Chinese ink-wash painting style (black ink brush strokes, paper texture, minimal color)? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.blue hour: Does the image show blue-hour lighting (deep blue twilight sky/ambient tones)? Answer YES or NO only.
questions.negative space: Is the composition dominated by large empty negative space with a small isolated subject? Answer YES or NO only.
